full_judgment:
9. If further appears that Rai Charan Barman, son of late Ram Kumar Barman, the vendor of the sale deed of the accused petitioners, had sworn an affidavit on 10.7.79, the very day when the petition of complaint was filed, with his photograph, wherein he described that he is the son of late Ram Kumar Barman @ Ananda Lal Barman and he being legal owner executed the deed of sale Ext. 1. This Rai Charan Barman was alive when the criminal case was filed but during pendency of the case after remand he died. One certificate dated 25.8.89 was given by one Md. Abdul Hamid, a member of ward No. 3 of No. 4 Mouzak union parishad, Upazila Kaliakair, District Dhaka. In that certificate it is stated that Rai Charan Barman was the son of Ram Kumar Barman @ Ananda Kumar Barman and he was the resident of his ward. The khatians Ext. B series (both old and new) show Rai Charan Barman, son of late Ram Kumar Barman as recorded owner. In both the Khatian Nos. 9 and 37, Rai Charan Barman's father's name was recorded as late Ram Kumar Barman. 

 15. Mr. Huq further submits that the learned Additional Sessions Judge remanded the case for re-hearing by the Magistrate by his order dated 19.6.81 in Criminal Revision No. 474 of 1979 giving 3 specific directions to be followed by the learned Magistrate. The 3 directions were, that both the par- ties be given chance to produce the documents of title of their vendors and the C.S. records of the disputed lands. They should be given further opportunity to examine the L.T.Is or signatures of the vendors of the sale deeds of both the parties through an ex- pert. But the prosecution had not filed any document of title of P.W. 2, the vendor of the deeds of the complainant P.W. l, nor any copy of C.S. records nor the complainant had taken steps to examine the L.T.Is or signatures of the vendors of the sale deeds of both the parties with the admitted L.T.Is and signatures through any expert. In a word, the complainant failed to produce any document to show that Rashik Chandra's (P.W. 2) father Rai Charan Barman, son of Raj Kumar Barman @ Raj Mohan Barman was the recorded owner. On the other hand, the old and new khatians of the disputed land Ext. B series show that Rai Charan, son of late Ram Kumar Barman, the vendor of the deed of the accused petitioners Ext. 1, was the recorded owner in both the khatians.
